primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: MB was defined as one of the following: Fatal bleeding; symptomatic bleeding in a critical area or organ, such as intracranial, intraspinal, intraocular, retroperitoneal, intraarticular if in a major joint, or pericardial, or intramuscular with compartment syndrome, clinically overt bleeding leading to transfusion of greater than or equal to (\>=) 2 units of packed red blood cells or whole blood or a fall in hemoglobin of 20 grams per liter (g/L) (1.24 millimoles per liter \[mmol/L\]) or more within 24 hours. CRNMB was defined as overt bleeding not meeting the criteria for MB but that resulted, in either medical examination, intervention, or had clinical consequences for a participant.
